diagnosis: Check C1 is a structural leak that passes in every rollout despite the decision-maker having no access to any of its required decisive facts (PF1, PF2, PF3, or PF4). The model correctly identifies the task order and windows by pattern-matching the sequential nature of the tasks, satisfying C1 without needing the specific time/date constraints hidden in the private facts.

C1.why: The reserved calibrated tester fixes V-31's first position and exact Tuesday 0800-1100 window, and identifies the tester reservation that must be copied to the company schedule.
The borrowed belt kit's Tuesday 1300-1500 availability fixes G-2's second position and exact two-hour window, and requires its loan paperwork to be reconciled.

The required two-hour service followed immediately by a two-hour medical validation fixes R-14's service window at 1600-1800 Tuesday and validation window at 1800-2000 Tuesday, and requires the validation requirement to be forwarded to maintenance control.

The Wednesday 0900 weighbridge booking fixes T-8's final position and its exact Wednesday 0700-0800 inspection window, and requires the weighbridge booking confirmation to be posted to the company work-order board.
